response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth with 20 years of software development experience and meaningful exposure to developer tools, CI/CD, and testing infrastructure, he lacks the essential people management experience required for this role. The position explicitly requires 2 years in people management or team leadership, which is entirely absent from his resume. His career shows consistent progression as an individual contributor (Developer → Senior Developer → Staff Developer) with no evidence of managing teams, conducting performance reviews, or organizational leadership. His technical expertise could be valuable as a senior engineer on the team, but he is not prepared for the full-time people-leadership responsibilities this manager position demands.
strengths: Exceptional technical breadth across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, data systems) with deep expertise in software craftsmanship, TDD, testing, and code quality
Significant experience with developer tooling infrastructure including CI/CD setup, testing frameworks (Selenium), Docker deployment, GitLab administration, and infrastructure automation
Strong community engagement and mentoring ability demonstrated through workshops, open-source projects (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial), and teaching initiatives
concerns: Complete absence of people management experience, team leadership roles, or responsibility for direct reports—a critical minimum requirement for this full-time people-leadership position
Career progression shows consistent individual contributor trajectory with no transition into management positions, never leading teams or handling organizational responsibilities

Developer tools experience is secondary; background is broadly distributed across full-stack development, GIS platforms, and various business domains rather than concentrated on build systems and testing infrastructure for mobile platforms

key_factors.factor: Absence of team leadership or organizational track record
Strong technical expertise and developer tooling exposure
